title: Mid-Market Account Executive - (Nordics)
description: Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com . Bitwarden is expanding its sales footprint and is looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive. This position is open to candidates currently residing within the UK. We are seeking an energetic and motivated sales professional with strong sales skills and channel experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 4-8 years of new account or business development experience with a proven track record of engaging the Partner ecosystem to drive success. In your role, you will be responsible for achieving an assigned quota number while also managing lead flow, closing deals, recruiting partners and developing geographical go to market plans. RESPONSIBILITIES Effective prospecting and lead management building a 3-5X pipeline within your territory Predominant focus on closing business in companies with between 51 and 1000 employees Managing and reporting a sales pipeline within our CRM, bringing the visibility of the revenue accurately, quarterly Territory planning and any sales support required Focus on activities and opportunities delivering short term and long-term revenue Effective and regular networking to attract and influence Partner sales and grow our Partner relationships Use your existing relationships to recruit and onboarding new partners, get them to agree to engage in proactive demand generation activities Maintain a regional partner plan mapping partner strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technology specialty) to accounts and target opportunities Track and manage lead flow both inbound and outbound between partners and the Bitwarden Sales team. Proactively communicate with Bitwarden sales leaders on the channel pipeline and forecast Work closely with marketing to deliver marketing events/programs/campaigns that create interest and awareness among partners' customers. Build and execute joint partner business plans with measurable success Set financial goals for focus partners and ensure goals achievement Drive multiple key channel initiatives in parallel across technical, professional services, and sales WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience 4-8 years of outside high-tech IT sales experience. IT security product experience is desirable but not mandatory Experience at a startup or pre $100M revenue company is desirable A proven track-record of driving continued partner growth and revenue Knowledge and strong relationships with SMB and SME focused resellers and MSP partners within a multistate region will be necessary Ability to drive influence and build effective relationships with decision makers across all levels of partner organizations Motivated and focused self-starter with strong leadership skills who can multitask, work independently or within a team Exceptional communication skills including listening, writing and public speaking. Can work in a fast paced, start-up environment An avid channel leader who knows how to teach, enable and motivate partners to find and close business Relationships and strong relationships with top VARs and Integrators Must demonstrate a consistent track record of achieving annual quota targets while providing specific details on key customer wins Possesses a competitive attitude, strong work ethic and thrives in a fast pace, high growth and matrixed organizational environment Positive history of collaborative selling Must be a proficient user of CRM tools and other Gsuite and MS Office tools WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages: Screening call with our Recruiting Manager Interview with our Head of Sales Enablement AE Roleplay Interview Final Interview with our CEO Reference Checks A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone––from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. Become an expert in a growing market. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. Learn and grow professionally. Embrace the opportunity to build up your demand generation and product-led growth expertise in a fast-growing startup. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Why Deliveroo? Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it. Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike. What You'll Be Doing You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions. Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation. For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports. Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants. You Will… Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders Skills & Experience You'll Need Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! title: Technical Writer, Frontier AI Best Practice
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2 class="vac_display_field"><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 29th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.</span></span></strong></h2> <h2><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">About the team</span></span></strong></h2> <p>AISI's Technical Standards and Best Practice team identifies what best practice is needed to manage the most serious risks from frontier AI development and leverages AISI’s position to get it adopted. </p> <p>AI capabilities are advancing faster than the science and practices used to manage their risks. Risks now emerge earlier, during training, internal deployment and evaluation, not just at public release, and evaluation methods are struggling to keep pace. Yet there is no consensus on the set of practices needed to safely use and develop the most capable AI systems, and high-level principles are not enough to manage these risks. What's needed is concrete technical guidance that developers agree is necessary. </p> <p>AISI is uniquely placed to lead on parts of this industry-wide effort to establish best practice. We house researchers with state-of-the-art technical insight on keeping AI secure during internal use, hold existing relationships with industry and other frontier AI organisations, and offer a neutral third-party home to establish best practice collaboratively. It builds <span data-contrast="auto">directly on our October 2026 publication </span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/towards-technical-best-practice-for-frontier-ai-development"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">, setting out our view of the most urgent priorities.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":60,"335559739":120,"335559740":259}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This is a new, growing team with high ambitions. title: Associate Director, Influence - Burson
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>Burson is building three global Influence & Social Centres of Excellence in the US, Singapore, and London. As part of our UK Centre of Excellence, which serves as the hub for the EMEA region, we are seeking an Associate Director, Influence to play a pivotal, hands-on role in scaling and evolving our Total Influence offer.</p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity for a mid-to-senior influencer specialist who combines strategic vision with flawless operational execution. Sitting within our multi-disciplinary capability, you will be the day-to-day strategic engine and trusted advisor across all agency practices. You will plan, oversee, and execute best-in-class influencer-led campaigns that earn cultural relevance, protect reputation, and deliver measurable business impact.</p> <p>As an Influence Associate Director, you will be a dynamic, commercially astute specialist and creative thinker, leading best-in-class, influencer-led content strategies and programmes across all agency sectors. Viewing "influence" holistically, you will provide strategic and practical counsel to clients and internal teams; from identification, vetting, and contracting to creative co-creation, paid integration, and measurement. Partnering with UK head of Influence, you will elevate Burson’s influencer marketing offer, inspire dedicated specialists, and upskill teams to deliver exceptional, measurable results.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p></p> <div> <h3>Grow: Commercial & Sector Partnership</h3> <ul> <li>Strategic Influence Partner: Act as a trusted adviser to sector and practice leads, translating client and business briefs into culturally relevant, influencer-led strategies.</li> <li>Commercial & Organic Growth: Partner with the UK Head of Influence and senior teams to develop winning pitches, shape commercial models and identify opportunities to grow influence across existing and new client accounts.</li> <li>Holistic Influence Strategy: Champion a broader view of influence beyond traditional creators, incorporating thought leaders, B2B voices, subject-matter experts and advocates across owned, earned, shared and paid channels.</li> </ul> <h3>Enable: Delivery, Operations & Best Practice</h3> <ul> <li>Best-in-Class Campaign Delivery: Lead end-to-end influencer programmes, from discovery, vetting and contracting through to creator briefing, co-creation, rights management and live campaign delivery.</li> <li>Creative, Paid & Performance Integration: Work closely with creators to deliver authentic, high-quality content while connecting organic influence with paid amplification, licensing, whitelisting and performance marketing opportunities.</li> <li>Governance, Tools & Team Development: Ensure programmes meet ASA, CMA, IP and Burson compliance standards, while embedding tools such as CreatorIQ and GWI and upskilling teams on influencer best practice, cultural trends and effective ways of working.</li> </ul> <h3>Transform: Innovation & Modern Measurement</h3> <ul> <li>Measurement & Impact: Partner with data and intelligence specialists to evolve how influence is measured, moving beyond vanity metrics to demonstrate sentiment, cultural share of voice, reputation shift and conversion.</li> <li>Platform & Innovation Leadership: Build strong relationships with platforms including TikTok, Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn, while testing and embedding AI and emerging capabilities through Burson's AI suite and WPP Open to improve discovery, reporting and workflow efficiency.</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven Agency Experience: Substantial influencer marketing experience within an agency, PR, or integrated creative environment, operating at Account Director / Junior Associate Director level.</li> <li>Strategic & Creative Rigour: Ability to plan multi-channel content strategies that are influencer-first, with a strong understanding of how audience mapping and data inform creative platforms and creator selection.</li> <li>Negotiation & Contracting Mastery: Deep practical expertise in creator negotiation, complex scope structuring, multi-platform licensing, exclusivity, and contract management.</li> <li>Tech Fluency: Hands-on proficiency with dedicated influencer tech platforms (specifically CreatorIQ) and consumer research tools (such as GWI).</li> <li>Collaborative Leadership: A natural relationship-builder who can seamlessly partner with cross-functional teams (strategy, creative, earned media, paid, data) and mentor junior talent.</li> <li>Client Advisory Skills: Calm, authoritative client-handling skills with the ability to articulate the strategic value of influencer marketing to both senior brand marketers and communications directors.</li> <li>Commercial Acumen: Experience building accurate scopes of work, production budgets, talent fees, and pitch responses that protect agency margins and client ROI.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!</strong></p> <p><strong>#LI-CY1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. description: Vilgain makes high-quality food - clean, functional ingredients, no shortcuts, no filler additives . We're 700+ people across Prague, Brno and London, already selling in 12+ markets across Europe, the UK, the US and beyond. We're on a mission to change how people think about food , and we're growing fast to do it - expanding internationally and building a company where people have a real say in what we make and how we make it, not just a seat at the table. Your mission 🎯 You'll own specific product development projects from brief to launch, working directly with third-party suppliers and manufacturers. Working closely with the Category Manager, you'll make sure every project is aligned with the wider category goals and launch plan, and spot the commercial opportunities that will help the category grow. What will you do? Owning end-to-end new product development projects, from initial brief through development to market launch. Running projects with third-party manufacturers – sourcing and selecting suppliers and managing those relationships day to day. Building the commercial case for your projects – costings, margins and volumes – and prioritising the opportunities with the highest value. Partnering with design, marketing, Regulatory and QA to bring products to market, including briefs, documentation and artwork sign-off. Monitoring market trends and identifying new commercial opportunities for the category. What do we expect from you? At least 3 years' experience in NPD, project management or a similar role in the food industry – food experience is essential. Experience with private label production and working with third-party manufacturers. Highly numerate and financially aware, with the commercial sense to prioritise high-value opportunities. Experience in a small business or startup environment – we move quickly, and you'll need to be happy with the fast pace of a rapidly growing business. Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to juggle several projects at once. A proactive problem-solver who takes initiative and can work independently. A strong communicator who can build good relationships with colleagues, both internally and externally. Confident with spreadsheets and project management tools, and actively uses AI tools to work smarter. A love for food and a genuine interest in making a difference to the food system. Fluent in English. What we offer: Based in London, hybrid – minimum 3 days a week in the office. Fast-paced, growing team where your work has a visible impact on the products we launch. 5 weeks of vacation, flexible hours, and remote work options, get monthly shopping credits. Stay connected through team events, breakfasts, and group workouts. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years. Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again. That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design. Sales Highlights You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls. What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs? Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for? The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't? A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next. Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science. The Opportunity As a Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B at Relay, you'll: Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix. Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like. Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision. Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools. Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre. Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends. We're looking for candidates who… Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards. Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one. Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it. Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes. Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't. Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast. Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. How we work We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work. We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart. We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move. Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest. A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer. The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve. Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting. Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you. Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating. Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve. Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps. Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity. Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them. Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on. Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated. title: Paralegal / Legal Engineer
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary We're looking for an early-career legal professional to help drive how Legal works at Dust. You'll shape and build legal processes and tools, and you'll get directly involved in a broad range of commercial legal matters, working under the supervision of Dust's lawyers. This role combines legal engineering and process improvement with hands-on experience in commercial contracting, including customer, vendor and partner matters. With a view to qualifying as a solicitor, the role may lead to consideration for an England & Wales training contract, subject to performance, business needs, eligibility and formal approval. A training contract is a potential pathway, not a guarantee. What you'll do Drive legal engineering and process improvement Identify recurring legal bottlenecks and design better ways for the company to get legal support. Translate legal rules and approved playbooks into practical workflows, templates, structured guidance and automations. Build and improve legal workflows using Dust and other appropriate tools, including intake, contract review and approval processes. Test workflows, gather feedback, document how they work and iterate to improve their quality and adoption. Build appropriate controls into processes, including lawyer review points, escalation paths and safeguards for confidential information. Get directly involved in commercial legal work Draft, review and prepare redlines for a wide range of commercial agreements, including NDAs, SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, DPAs, vendor contracts and partnership agreements. Support negotiation and deal execution with Sales, GTM and other teams, including participating in discussions when appropriate and under lawyer supervision. Help identify legal, privacy, data protection, security and AI-related issues in commercial matters, and bring them to the right lawyer for review. Conduct legal research, prepare issue summaries and help develop practical options for resolving contract questions. Progressively take on more responsibility as your experience and judgment develop, while escalating non-standard or higher-risk issues to qualified counsel. Build the legal team's capabilities Help create and improve templates, playbooks, legal knowledge resources and tools that allow the wider company to handle routine work more consistently. Use and improve systems that make matter status, contract obligations and key deadlines visible, rather than relying on manual follow-up. Work with the General Counsel, Commercial Counsel and external counsel across a varied commercial workload. Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency . Aptitude Legal training, such as a law degree, paralegal qualification or equivalent experience. Some experience in a paralegal, legal assistant, commercial contracts or legal operations role is helpful. We're also open to strong early-career candidates. Clear legal writing, research and issue-spotting skills, with an interest in commercial law. Interest or experience in process design, automation, no-code or low-code tools, AI workflows or contract-management systems. Business-standard English is required. Business-standard French is a strong advantage, but not essential. Willingness to travel to the US or Paris from time to time when required. Attitude Curious and motivated to develop as a commercial legal professional. Organised, careful and discreet when handling confidential information. A clear communicator who is comfortable asking questions, surfacing uncertainty and taking feedback. Collaborative and pragmatic, with a genuine interest in helping colleagues move work forward. Agency Proactively identifies opportunities to improve how legal work is done, then helps design and build the solution. Takes ownership of process improvements from problem definition through implementation, testing and iteration. Gets directly involved in commercial legal matters and follows them through within the level of responsibility agreed with supervising lawyers. Uses judgment to move work forward while escalating decisions that require qualified legal review. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. title: Strategic Account Executive
description: 📍Manchester (Hybrid) | 💰 Basic £50k, realistic £100k OTE Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. Join our Enterprise Sales team to drive new business growth across Spectre and Street.co.uk . With the support of our industry-leading, multi-award-winning prospecting and CRM technology, you’ll have the opportunity to drive new business, close high-value deals, and play a key role in shaping the future of PropTech in the UK. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to spearhead enterprise-level sales, working closely with our VP of Sales to drive revenue growth. You’ll be responsible for prospecting, engaging, and closing high-value deals, selling to board-level stakeholders and securing strategic partnerships. This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to multi-thread across complex organisations to drive adoption of our full product suite. If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in! A bit about you… You have 2+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record in enterprise sales. Enterprise sales strategy expertise, including account mapping, multi-threading, and engaging multiple stakeholders. Strong outbound prospecting skills, with experience in either Challenger, Gap Selling or PClub sales methodology, MEDDIC qualification methodology, forecasting, and ABM/ABS strategies. Exceptional negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-makers and close high-value deals. Consultative sales approach, able to understand business challenges and position tailored solutions. Resilience, confidence, and presence - you can hold the room, drive conversations, and articulate value effectively. A team player mindset, working collaboratively across departments to drive success. Coachability, always seeking to refine your approach and stay ahead in enterprise sales best practices. Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Strategic Account Executive at Street Group Executing ABM/ABS strategies, identifying and targeting key accounts with a structured approach. Prospecting and outbound outreach, using cold calling, email, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities. Managing and optimising CRM data, ensuring accurate tracking of leads, interactions, and progress. Conducting research on industries, prospects, and competitors to craft personalised outreach. Handling objections with confidence, positioning value-driven solutions tailored to client needs. Collaborating with our Technical Pre-Sales team to map prospect workflows and demonstrate how Street transforms the way their agency operates end to end. Developing strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within a business to drive engagement. Becoming a product expert, understanding how our solutions solve industry challenges. Refining sales processes and methodologies, working closely with leadership to enhance effectiveness. Collaborating with sales, marketing, and a Strategic SDR to ensure seamless lead handoff, targeted outreach, and effective nurture strategies. Continuously improving performance, embracing feedback, and adapting to new strategies and insights. You probably shouldn't apply if: You've only ever done inside sales. This role is field-based, and roughly half your time is out with customers. You need a fully qualified pipeline handed to you. Prospecting and pipeline generation are core to the role. You're expecting a job where you can coast on existing relationships. We're hunting for new business into accounts we don't yet own. You're looking for a fully remote role. We need you in the Manchester office a minimum of three days per week, every other week, and out with customers the rest of the time. You think your product knowledge matters more than your ability to sell. We'll teach you the product; your commercial acumen is what we're hiring. Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application! Who are Street Group? We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone. Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK. title: Global Sales Director, Energy & AI
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🏡 Where you’ll fit in You’ll lead sales leaders and teams across Liberalised and Regulated Flexibility, Field & Assets, and Agentic Customer Service. Each area has different buyers, sales cycles, regulatory environments, and product maturity. Your job is to give each team clear direction while making the right choices for Kraken as a whole. You’ll partner with General Managers and colleagues across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Marketing, Partnerships, Legal, and Finance. Together, you’ll bring customers a joined-up experience and make sure what we sell is commercially sound and deliverable. 🚀 What you’ll own Build a global go-to-market strategy with clear priorities for products, markets, customer segments, and routes to market. Decide where we have the strongest opportunity to win, where to invest, and where to pause or stop. Turn the strategy into practical plans for target accounts, pipeline, team capacity, partnerships, and performance. Balance near-term revenue with the customer proof points and capabilities we need for lasting growth. Lead and develop the team Lead and coach sales leaders and their teams, setting clear expectations while giving them the space to make decisions. Build a culture of ownership, trust, high standards, and mutual support. Help people raise risks early and learn from wins and losses. Identify gaps in skills, capacity, succession, and hiring, and build the team needed to deliver the plan. Own commercial performance Be accountable for results across the portfolio, including revenue quality, margin, sales productivity, customer commitments, and the cost of growth. Set clear commercial principles, pricing discipline, and approval boundaries so teams can negotiate confidently and protect Kraken’s value. Look beyond headline contract value. Assess commitments, delivery and implementation effort, partner costs, product dependencies, and potential for expansion. Lead or support strategic bids and complex negotiations when you can improve the outcome, while keeping the opportunity owner accountable. Work with Legal and Finance on deal structures and risks, making decisions within your remit and escalating when needed. Build a reliable sales operation Establish a consistent rhythm for pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, account planning, and performance discussions. Produce clear, evidence-based forecasts that distinguish pipeline from likely outcomes and committed business, including risks and revenue timing. Challenge assumptions, spot slippage early, and agree practical next steps with the relevant leaders. Use customer relationship management data to improve visibility and decisions, and connect pipeline plans to targets, capacity, and investment. Bring teams together around customers Bring customer demand, market insight, and competitive context into product and investment decisions. Make sure sales commitments reflect what we can deliver. Where dependencies block an opportunity, make the impact clear and follow through on decisions and ownership. Help teams make trade-offs between bespoke customer work and scalable products, and coordinate account ownership across the portfolio. Build strong relationships across regions and time zones, communicate decisions clearly, and travel for customers, team development, and important commercial discussions. 🧠 What you’ll bring to the party Significant senior sales leadership experience in the energy sector, ideally selling enterprise software or technology to utilities, energy retailers, networks, generators, asset owners, or related organizations. A strong understanding of energy customers, their operating models and buying environments, and the problems technology can help them solve. Experience leading and developing sales leaders or multidisciplinary sales teams across more than one product, market, or region. A track record of setting a go-to-market strategy, making clear choices about where to focus, and turning it into a credible pipeline and contracted growth. Strong commercial judgment, including enterprise pricing, negotiation, deal economics, contracting, margin, and long-term customer value. Forecasting discipline: you can inspect a pipeline, explain what’s real, and act early when a deal or target is at risk. Confidence with senior customer executives and complex deals, alongside a commitment to helping your team own its relationships. Experience building supportive, accountable teams, coaching people, and addressing performance issues. The ability to bring teams together across a matrix, resolve competing priorities, and make reasoned decisions when products and information are evolving. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to move between strategy and practical deal detail. ⭐️ Bonus points Experience selling agentic AI enterprise software or translating AI capabilities into credible customer value and responsible implementation plans. Experience leading teams across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, or working across multiple time zones and regulatory environments. Knowledge of energy flexibility, distributed energy resources, demand response, virtual power plants, field service, or mobile workforce management. Experience building partnerships and routes to market, including managing ownership across partner-led or multi-party opportunities. Are you ready for a career with us? title: QA Engineer
description: <p><em>We are the UK's leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men's & Women's Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper's Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don't just create content – we shape culture.</em></p> <p><em>Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that's brought us here. We believe in each other's potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people's lives.</em></p> <p><em>We're proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history.</em></p> <p><em>Hearst UK operates an in-office policy with flexible Fridays. Our office is based at <strong>House of Hearst, 30 Panton Street, St James's, London, SW1Y 4AJ</strong>, where teams collaborate in person and connect across brands and functions.</em></p> <p><strong>Salary - Circa £55,000 - </strong>Salary is dependent on experience and will be assessed in line with the candidate's skills, knowledge and relevant expertise.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Role…</strong></p> <p>As our QA Engineer, you’ll play a key role in making sure Hearst’s websites and apps deliver a seamless, reliable experience for millions of users across the UK. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering and Editorial teams, you’ll test new features, challenge how things work, uncover issues and help bring great digital experiences to life.</p> <p>You’ll work across our global platforms, making sure new developments are not only technically robust, but work brilliantly for our UK audiences. From new product launches to everyday improvements, you’ll help set the standard for quality at every stage of the journey.</p> <p><strong>Main Duties…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan and carry out testing for website and app features across different devices, browsers and operating systems.</li> <li>Check that changes meet agreed requirements and work well for people using our products.</li> <li>Report bugs clearly, including steps to reproduce them, and work with engineers to confirm fixes.</li> <li>Run regression tests to check that new releases have not affected existing features.</li> <li>Contribute to test plans and release checks throughout the development process.</li> <li>Work with engineering teams on optimising automated testing by identifying suitable test cases. </li> <li>Use AI enabled testing tools and workflows to help identify risks, improve test coverage and make quality checks more efficient.</li> <li>Raise usability, accessibility and performance concerns with the relevant teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience testing websites and mobile apps, with a clear understanding of functional and regression testing.</li> <li>Confidence using different devices, browsers and operating systems to identify and investigate issues.</li> <li>The ability to write clear bug reports and communicate findings to technical and non-technical colleagues.</li> <li>A methodical approach, good attention to detail and the judgement to prioritise issues by their impact on users.</li> <li>Familiarity with test management or bug tracking tools, such as Jira.</li> <li>Some experience with test automation tools or basic scripting; this is desirable.</li> <li>A collaborative mindset and interest in improving the quality and accessibility of digital products.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits… </strong></p> <p>(Your benefits at Hearst UK are more than just extras—they are tools to help you thrive in every part of life. </p> <p><strong>Hearst Exclusives - Only for You! </strong></p> <ul> <li>Get adventurous with Good Housekeeping Taste and Beauty Testing Panels - yes, you could be trying the next big thing in beauty, food & drink. </li> <li>Snag luxe beauty steals at our legendary office sample sales - score big on top brands without breaking the bank!  </li> </ul> <p><strong>Inclusion, Health & Wellbeing: Feel Your Best </strong></p> <ul> <li>Stay healthy with Specsavers eye care, a company-funded Health Cash Plan, and access to mental health support. </li> <li>Get active and stress-free with discounted gym memberships and the Cycle to Work scheme. </li> <li>Embrace flexibility with a Location Flex and Holiday Exchange to take time when you need it. </li> <li>Take time to give back with a Charity Day and access wellbeing resources whenever you need them. </li> <li>Join one of our Hearst ERG Groups. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Wellness - Boost Your Budget </strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan ahead with a generous Workplace Pension, Income Protection, Life Assurance and Season Ticket Loan for easier commuting. </li> <li>Make smarter money moves using Salary Finance tools, Financial Wellbeing sessions, and Home Tech benefits to spread costs. </li> <li>Treat yourself with major discounts across London plus everyday savings via the HAPI at Hearst app </li> </ul> <p><strong>Hearst UK is deeply committed to using our influential brands to reflect the world we want to live in – one that respects, protects, represents and uplifts the voices and opinions of all people. As a business, we recognise the significant benefits of creativity, collaboration and innovation that comes with diverse teams. Not only is diversifying the voices in our organization the right thing to do, but it also helps us to make powerful and exciting content that can be enjoyed by many more people. This is why we’re working to build a sense of true belonging within our business and foster a culture in which everyone feels heard. </strong></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Director
description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team Our Retail and Consumer team is dedicated to helping clients deliver their strategic objectives through the successful application of Data Science and Frontier AI. Our work spans the full spectrum of AI capabilities from machine learning to computer vision, simulation, optimisation, generative AI, agentic systems, and bringing these capabilities together in decision intelligence applications. Our solutions help clients understand and better engage with customers, improve commercial and trading decisions, improve the efficiency of end to end operations, and improve colleague experience. About the role As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts and shape our go-to-market strategy in order to achieve our ambitious growth targets. You will act as a strategic partner to our Retail clients, helping them reinvent the way they engage with customers, and the way they operate across commercial, supply chain, stores, online and support functions with AI. You will build enduring relationships with senior stakeholders, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact. This is an opportunity to help build a distinctive practice inside a company with world-class technical depth and the ambition to set the standard for AI in the Retail sector. The ideal candidate will be T-shaped: broad enough to advise across AI for a range of firms including adjacent consumer facing sectors, with deep experience in Grocery and/or Fashion & Apparel sectors. title: Platform Engineer
description: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will initially join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a strong security focus, and it will become more security focused over time. Much of the work is compliance and assurance: building and running the tooling that checks our cloud estate against our security standards, writing the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one, gathering the evidence we need for ISO 27001 and our other obligations, and supporting the audits that depend on it. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. Over time this role moves across to work directly with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security function at ManyPets. You will help shape what that function does and how it works, rather than inheriting something already built. Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: · All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. · We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. · We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations o Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on. o Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable. o Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it. o Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. o Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads. Make our security posture measurable o Automate the gathering of evidence for ISO 27001 and our other compliance obligations, so that an audit means pulling a report rather than running a manual exercise. o Write the scripts and small services that turn a manual security check into a scheduled, repeatable one. o Triage findings from our scanning and posture tooling such as Aikido and Ascidian, work out which ones actually matter, and either fix them or get them in front of the team that can. o Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling. Strengthen access and identity controls o Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. o Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. o Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. Extend our platform standards beyond AWS o Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. o Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are. Team collaboration o Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions. o Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously. o Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews. o Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance. Self development o Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan. o Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset. o Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship. Your skills and experience We are looking for someone with: · Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure). · Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code. · Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines. · A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals. · Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python. · Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously. You will also need at least one current associate-level cloud certification: · AWS: Solutions Architect Associate, Developer Associate or SysOps Administrator Associate. We would also be interested in the AWS Certified Security Speciality. · Google Cloud: Associate Cloud Engineer. · Microsoft Azure: Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500). Entry-level certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, Google Cloud Digital Leader and Azure Fundamentals do not meet this on their own. Please include the certification name and your credential ID or badge link with your application. We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other: · A security specialism, where you can tell us about security or compliance tooling you have built and what it caught. · Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud. The interview process This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom. · Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team. · Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need. · Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise. · Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security. About the team The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about. Our tech stack We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas. Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics. description: Introduction to Role & Team Bumble Inc. is looking for an Integrity Operations Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. You’ll investigate safety concerns, review accounts and content against Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines, and provide compassionate, trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents. You’ll work across a range of complex and sensitive issues, using established policies, operational guidance, sound judgment, and AI-supported tools to reach fair and consistent outcomes. You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another. This role will be based in the U.K. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager. Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes. Review accounts and content flagged for potential safety violations, applying policies and operational guidance consistently while using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps. Manage sensitive and time-critical cases with attention to detail, taking ownership of your work and seeing cases through from initial review to an appropriate outcome. Collaborate purposefully with Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Legal, and other partners to escalate and help resolve cases that require additional expertise or support. description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system. Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage. Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call. Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant. What you bring Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business. A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders. Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping. Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation. Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the human oversight regulated casework requires. Familiarity with a surveillance platform (such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus, or NICE Actimize) and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering. Clear, evidence-first written communication - your case files, escalations and regulatory drafts will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.
