title: Product Engineer
description: About Adclear At Adclear, we’re building the trust layer for how the world’s most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We’re turning the function that has always said “no” into infrastructure that says “yes, and here’s how.” This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we’re only at the beginning. The product you’ll help build is what people actually touch when they experience that shift. Founded in 2024, we’ve already earned the trust of leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, NatWest, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise £2.6m in funding, and we’re now scaling fast. We’re building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in. The Role This is a full-stack product engineering role for someone who has shipped real features and wants to take on more ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers and the founders on product slices from spec to production. Over time you’ll own them end-to-end. Here’s the kind of work you’ll contribute to: A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. It was built with Monzo as the design partner and is public on the Chrome Web Store. A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, and the action runs. The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules. Integrations that reach into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com , and Frame.io for video. A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue. Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day and tell us quickly when something’s wrong. That tight feedback loop is one of the best things about the job, and it’s a fast way to grow. What you’ll do Ship product features from spec to production. Most of the work is across the full stack, and integration work where needed. You’ll start with guidance and take on bigger slices as you grow. Build the surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, and the moments where model output meets human judgement. Work on features where AI is in the critical path. The model is genuinely part of the product, not bolted on. Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first few weeks. We deploy continuously, so you’ll feel the pace immediately. Bring your perspective to what we build and how we build it. We want to hear when something doesn’t make sense. Learn from senior engineers through code review, pairing and design discussions, and help raise the bar yourself. What we’re looking for Proven delivery. Building production web applications, with features you’ve shipped that real users depend on. Growing ownership. You can take a well-scoped feature and run with it. You know when to ask for input and when to unblock yourself. You want to grow towards owning larger, more ambiguous pieces of work. Product sense. You care about the user experience, notice when something feels off, and aren’t afraid to say so. You’re learning to balance polish against shipping at pace. Collaboration. You communicate clearly with engineers, designers and founders, ask good questions when something is underspecified, and are receptive to feedback. AI literacy. You use modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents) day to day. You treat them as collaborators, check their output critically, and are curious about where they help and where they get in the way. Technical skills Solid TypeScript and React, with working experience on the backend. Experience with, or a strong interest in, building products where AI is in the critical path. Familiarity with modern web tooling, including Node and Postgres. Nice to have Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Hono or Drizzle. Exposure to regulated industries such as fintech, healthtech or legaltech. The Stack React, TypeScript and Tailwind on the frontend. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle and Postgres on the data layer. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Nutrition</strong></p> <p data-start="353" data-end="578">THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.</p> <p data-start="580" data-end="776">Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.</p> <p></p> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">Role: Senior Assistant Merchandiser </strong></div> <div><strong>Brand: Myprotein</strong></div> <div><strong>Reporting to: Merchandising Manager</strong></div> <div><strong>Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF (fully office based) </strong></div> <div> </div> <div><strong>About the Role</strong></div> <div> </div> <div>We are seeking a highly organised, analytical, and proactive <strong>Senior Assistant Merchandiser</strong> to join the MP Activewear Clothing team. This role supports the merchandising function through delivering reporting and analysis that drives key business KPIs, while helping to manage intake and optimise stock performance. The successful candidate will also support the development of junior team members and contribute to the overall success of the team.</div> <div>You will work closely with the Merchandiser and wider teams to help drive sales performance through assisting with range planning, while maintaining strong control over intake and managing key intake deliverables.</div> <div> </div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></div> <ul> <li>Support in preparing department trade performance analysis, identify opportunities to maximise bestsellers and support the clearance of underperforming stock.</li> <li>Proposing pricing (reprices and markdowns), understanding the relationship and importance of pricing in relation to margin, sell-through rates and other key deliverables.</li> <li>Assist the Merchandiser in managing the Line Card/Rebuy forecasting process, with a clear understanding of supplier lead times and seasonality, to make decisions which positively drive sales and profitability.</li> <li>Support Range Plan forecasting, stock planning, promotional activity and seasonal launches.</li> <li>Assists with ad-hoc reporting to inform decision making across Buying & Merch teams.</li> <li>Overseeing the critical path process, ensuring timely delivery in line with the department key deliverables.</li> <li>Overseeing junior team member development & identifies opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies and ways of working.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></div> <ul> <li>Relevant merchandising experience operating at Assistant Merchandiser level & looking to progress into a more senior position.</li> <li>Experience using Power BI or similar software to aid reporting is preferable.</li> <li>Strong commercial awareness, numerical and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.</li> <li>Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities independently.</li> <li>Confident communicator with strong problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Strong IT skills, particularly Excel.</li> <li>Positive, self-motivated team player with a continuous improvement mindset </li> </ul> title: Front End Design Engineer
description: About Seamflow Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files. Where we are: Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze. Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists. The team Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further. The role A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them. You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week. What we're looking for We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not. What we're actually screening for: You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better. You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters. You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is. You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful. You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says. Signals we like, none of them required: design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup. This is probably not for you if You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch. You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning. You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane. What you get Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Backend Engineer - Partner Flow
description: Backend Engineer - Partner Flow Team Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Partner Flow team. This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca. The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include: Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily. Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market. Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works. In this role, you will: Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives. Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations. The Challenge We are seeking researchers who: See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative. It's Important to Us That You Have Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI Ideal Researcher Profile An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models. 1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations Mastery of Core Concepts Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse. Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights. Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses. 2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts. Turning Theory into Practice Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential. Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress. 3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models. Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance. 4. Hardware & Systems Understanding Efficient Implementations at Scale Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices. Real-Time & On-Device Constraints SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness. Architectural & Optimization Details Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency. 5. Rigorous Experimental Design Controlled Comparisons & Ablations Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter. Multifold Evaluation Metrics From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics. We need engineers who can build the products, APIs and tools our customers use, and who understand the systems underneath well enough to make them work reliably in production.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who takes a loosely defined problem, works out what the user actually needs, and owns the solution end to end. That means designing it, writing the code, shipping it, and debugging it when it breaks, without handing it off at the first layer boundary.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING</strong></p> <p>Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Own and drive user-facing products end to end, including web apps, APIs, backend services and CLI tools, mostly in Go. You’ll ship the simplest useful version first, then improve it based on how people actually use it.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering & DevOps, Infrastructure & Data Centre Operations, Security and Customer Support. You’ll turn real customer problems into practical solutions.</li> <li>Build and maintain Kubernetes-based services, controllers and platform capabilities. This includes GPU scheduling and container runtimes.</li> <li>Identify repetitive operational work and replace it with automation, so software handles it instead of people.</li> <li>Investigate production issues across application code, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, networking, drivers and hardware. Each incident should end in a lasting fix, a guardrail or better tooling.</li> <li>Design services that behave well under load and during failure. You’ll instrument them so anyone can debug them, and give them secure defaults from day one.</li> <li>Contribute ideas and take ownership beyond your core remit. That includes product decisions on workflow and interface, such as whether a problem is best solved with a CLI, an API or a web experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ABOUT YOU</strong></p> <p>We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><em>Essential:</em></p> <ul> <li>Strong professional experience building, debugging and operating production software in Go. Deep experience in another systems language also works, if you can show you’d become productive in Go quickly.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containers, including how workloads are scheduled, how services communicate, and how to investigate when things misbehave.</li> <li>Confidence in Linux environments: systemd, processes, signals, filesystems, permissions, networking, and CPU and memory diagnostics.</li> <li>A track record of systems, products or tools you personally designed and built.</li> <li>Solid engineering fundamentals: concurrency, API and interface design, and failure modes. You’ll also have practical experience troubleshooting production systems with logs, metrics and system-level tooling.</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to Have:</em></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem, such as drivers, CUDA, nvidia-smi, GPU-enabled container runtimes or Kubernetes GPU scheduling. This isn’t essential: strong systems debugging and a genuine interest in learning this area count just as much.</li> <li>Experience with distributed and event-driven systems, such as queues, retries, idempotency and backpressure. Practical networking knowledge (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing) also helps.</li> <li>Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators, or developer tooling used by other engineers. A security-minded approach to auth, secrets and attack surfaces is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme</li> <li>Employee wellbeing benefits</li> <li>25 days holiday, plus public holidays</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance</li> <li>Enhanced Pension Scheme</li> <li>Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)</li> <li>Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment</li> <li>Visible, meaningful impact as we scale</li> <li>Clear career progression in a high-growth company</li> <li>A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership</li> <li>The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY APPLY</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></p> <p>Visit our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers">careers page</a> to learn more about us or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.</p> <p></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Our Mission: Why Lighthouse? </strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are <strong><span style="color: rgb(253, 130, 55);">Lumineers</span></strong>. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="color: rgb(253, 130, 55);"><strong>Meaningful work matters</strong></span>: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="color: rgb(253, 130, 55);"><strong>Elevate each other</strong></span>: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship? 🚀</span></p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Job Details</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">💼 Revenue </span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">📍 United Kingdom</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">🕜 Full-Time/Remote </span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What you will do</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You’ll be the face of Lighthouse for new customers, owning the full sales cycle from first cold touch to close. This is a hunter role: you carry a quota, you build your own pipeline, and you’re accountable to outcomes and success. No excuses, just results. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Your market is two-sided. You open net-new accounts that fit our ideal customer profile and have never spoken to us, and you turn low-adoption customers who use a single Lighthouse product into full-platform customers. In both cases the goal is the same: the whole commercial platform, not one module. Small, one-off transactions are not what this role is for. You think in terms of the full deal from the first conversation, and you have the patience and the process to run a complex, multi-stakeholder cycle to get there. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What makes this different: you won’t do it alone. Lighthouse is deploying an agent AI infrastructure — Enablement, Pre-Sales, and Coaching agents — alongside a modern revenue stack. AI handles the prep, the sequencing, and the pattern recognition so you can focus on what matters — building relationships, running sharp discovery, and closing deals.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Where you will have impact</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Own your territory and your number. </strong>Build and execute a strategic territory plan to generate a net-new pipeline. Maintain 3x pipeline coverage, forecast honestly, and take full accountability for your results. Your quota is your commitment. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Hunt into net-new accounts. </strong>Cold, outbound prospecting into ideal customer profile accounts is the core of this role, not a supplement to inbound. Run an AI-first workflow: use our agents for account research, buying signals, sequencing and first-touch personalization, so your time goes into conversations rather than admin. Add Lighthouse Connect events and industry conferences on top. This is not an SDR-reliant role. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Expand low-adoption customers. </strong>Identify customers who use a single Lighthouse product, or a fraction of what they bought, and turn them into full-platform accounts. Run this as a sales cycle, with discovery, a business case and a close, not as an adoption program. Work with Customer Success on the handover so the account is set up to keep growing. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Turn small deals into big deals. </strong>Treat every opportunity as a platform deal. Qualify for the full scope early, bring in every stakeholder who has a say, and build the business case for the whole solution rather than settling for a trial or a single module. Protect pricing on value. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Run a disciplined sales process. </strong>Using MEDDPICC to qualify and advance opportunities. Use the AI Pre-Sales Agent to identify gaps before every major call. Advance deals through stage gates with evidence, not optimism. Leverage AI to make your days easier and focus on more selling time. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Use AI as a force multiplier. </strong>Leverage the Enablement Agent for call prep, discovery frameworks, and positioning. Use the Coaching Agent to surface patterns in your pipeline and win rate. Push back on the tools when they’re wrong — help make the system smarter. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Become a hospitality expert. </strong>Understand the commercial challenges hotels face across pricing, distribution, and business intelligence. Position Lighthouse’s full platform as the integrated solution that replaces fragmented point tools. Know the competitive landscape inside out and run value based ROI conversations confidently. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Build relationships at a distance. </strong>Most of your buyers will never meet you in person. Earn trust over video, phone and email through sharp preparation, clear follow-through and a point of view on their business. Partner with Product to share market feedback and influence the roadmap, and represent Lighthouse at industry events to build the brand and your network. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About our team</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You’ll join a global Revenue team of 150+ sales professionals across 24 countries. The Acquisition team is where new revenue starts: we open the accounts the rest of the company grows. We work across the full Lighthouse product suite, helping hotels, chains, and hospitality groups achieve their commercial goals. It’s a collaborative, high-energy environment that celebrates wins loudly, with real opportunities for career growth and the chance to learn from experienced leaders.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What's in it for you?</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Flexible working environment: Work from home or at one of our global offices.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Comprehensive health insurance: Private AXA coverage for you and your family.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Career development: Workshops and frameworks to realize your full potential.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Wellbeing support: Subsidized up to 80% ClassPass subscription.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Additional maternity leave compensation: For the first 12 weeks of Statutory Maternity Pay (SMP), we top-up your SMP so that your salary reaches 100%</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; title: Senior Quality Systems Engineer, United Kingdom
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>Anduril’s Quality organization is seeking a Quality Systems Engineer to join our London team and help develop future opportunities for our internal quality management system and digitization efforts. The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge Quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success.<br>We are growing and this role will focus on internal site growth and implementing a world-class quality management system, supporting our internal manufacturing sites, supplier sites, and allied facilities. This role carries responsibility for ensuring compliance with UK and European regulatory frameworks, NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace, and UK Ministry of Defense (MOD) requirements as part of our London operations.<br>The right person for this role has extensive knowledge in Quality Management System (QMS) systems, data analysis, and continuous improvement to help shape our internal systems, tools, procedures and the culture of quality at Anduril. If you are someone who loves to build world-class Quality processes, work hands-on, help others succeed on the quality journey, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.</p> <h3><strong>About the Job</strong></h3> <p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a real time, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.<br><br></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop, lead, and manage the execution of the QMS and its top-level processes. Coordinate resources and prioritization of tasks to complete internal and external audits of the QMS.</li> <li>Develop, lead, and manage the execution of the QMS software implementation and adoption across Anduril sites, including the London facility. Defense Standards (DEF STANs), UKCA marking where applicable, and relevant UK Health & Safety Executive (HSE) regulations for defense manufacturing environments.</li> <li>Drive compliance with NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107 (Mutual Acceptance of Government Quality Assurance and Usage of the Allied Quality Assurance Publications), STANAG 4159 (NATO Quality Assurance Requirements for Design, Development and Production — AQAP-2110), and STANAG 4161 (NATO Quality Management System Requirements for Aviation, Space and Defense — AQAP-2310).</li> <li>Ensure conformance to STANAG 4404 and associated AQAPs for software-intensive aerospace systems, including AQAP-2210 (NATO Supplementary Software Quality Assurance Requirements) as applicable to Lattice OS and embedded mission systems.</li> <li>Support implementation of STANAG 4685 (Airworthiness) requirements as they relate to quality assurance processes for unmanned aerial systems and aerospace components.</li> <li>Liaise with the UK MOD Quality Assurance representatives, the Defence Quality Assurance (DQA) organisation, and NATO Quality Assurance authorities to support Government Quality Assurance (GQA) activities and audits.</li> <li>Partner with business systems team, product quality engineers and manufacturing engineers to help prepare new processes, digital tools, and sites to meet QMS requirements, develop new capabilities to meet existing QMS requirements and conduct internal audits before manufacturing readiness review and production readiness review.</li> <li>Develop our internal QMS road map for tools and capabilities to match the scaling of the company: to meet customer needs, to enable quality capabilities for new products, and scale quality processes as we grow — with particular attention to UK Export Control and ITAR/EAR interface requirements.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with UK data protection requirements (UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018) as they relate to quality records, supplier data, and audit documentation.</li> <li>Become a systems expert for Anduril’s quality tools, processes, and data sets to enable effective QMS execution across both US and UK operations.</li> <li>Communicate with external audit agencies, including UKAS-accredited certification bodies and NATO quality assurance authorities. Support customer audits as necessary.</li> <li>Manage the QMS internal audit program and lead internal audits.</li> <li>Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities that benefit the QMS and product quality, aligned with AS9100, NATO AQAP, and STANAG frameworks.</li> <li>Support investigations, initiatives, and projects as needed, at the team or organisation level.</li> <li>Support developing QMS training modules and packages, including UK/NATO-specific regulatory and STANAG training. Facilitate training records and retention with manager of affected trainees.</li> <li>Drive root cause analysis and corrective action with internal findings from audits and customer visits, including UK MOD and NATO audit findings.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 3–5 years of experience in aerospace and/or defence manufacturing.</li> <li>Expert knowledge of QMS requirements and auditing in a complex product environment, in one or more of the following QMS standards: ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, AS9110C, AS9120B, AS6500, IATF 16949:2016, ISO 13485:2016, TL 9000 R6.3.</li> <li>Demonstrable knowledge of NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107, STANAG 4159, STANAG 4161, and their associated Allied Quality Assurance Publications (AQAPs): AQAP-2110, AQAP-2210, and AQAP-2310.</li> <li>Familiarity with UK MOD Defence Standards (DEF STANs) and Government Quality Assurance (GQA) processes.</li> <li>Understanding of UK regulatory frameworks relevant to defence manufacturing, including UK Export Control Act 2002, HSE regulations, and UKCA/CE marking requirements.</li> <li>Working knowledge with QMS software solutions which might include Net Inspect, Siemens, SAP, ETQ, One Factory, MasterControl, Compliance Quest, Hexagon, PTC, QT9.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with data analytics platforms, reporting tools, and basic data visualisation.</li> <li>Demonstrated project management for software system implementation and onboarding suppliers (external users) and internal users.</li> <li>Working knowledge of design, development, manufacturing, supply chain, deployment, contracts, and other organisations that are part of a company-wide audit.</li> <li>Knowledge of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and Business Intelligence (BI) systems.</li> <li>A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive projects from start to completion.</li> <li>Proven track record of implementation and success with QMS.</li> <li>Right to work in the United Kingdom.</li> <li>Expected travel up to 20% of the time, including travel to US facilities and NATO partner sites.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. </span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p> </p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. title: Head of India
description: The Role India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market. You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it. As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels. Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO What You'll Own The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win. Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it. Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor. The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships. Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support. The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply. The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast. Who You Are 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do. Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why. Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus. A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three. A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle. Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets. Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job. Why This Role India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home. The Role We are hiring a Product Lead to own our Express / Mid-prime personal loan product, one of our highest-priority growth areas. This is unsecured personal lending in the higher-APR mid-prime space (30% to 50% APR), with loans typically from £2,000 to £10,000, and customers acquired primarily through price-comparison and aggregator marketplaces. Our ambition is to grow this product many times over while improving its economics, and this role owns the product that makes that happen. This is a product role first. You will own the Express/Mid-prime proposition end to end: who we serve, how we quote and present offers on marketplaces, how the journey converts, how we price, and how the product performs once the loans are on the book. What makes it different from a typical product role is that the product is credit. The levers that drive growth, such as eligibility, pricing, offer design and underwriting, are the same levers that drive loss rates, so you need to be comfortable working with risk and data science rather than handing that part off. We think this is a great role for someone with around four to five years of experience who has built a strong foundation in lending or fintech, has worked hands-on with data and credit decisioning, and is ready to own a product outright rather than a slice of one. You will set the direction for the segment, run the roadmap, and be accountable for the results, with the backing of experienced risk, data science and commercial leaders around you. Our decisioning is built on Open Banking and cashflow underwriting rather than credit scores alone. For a higher-APR population acquired through marketplaces, seeing real affordability is what lets us select and price better than the market. The interesting product problem is that richer data comes at a cost to conversion, so the job is to capture that data advantage while designing a journey and offer that customers actually complete. The defining challenge is balance: scaling volume by an order of magnitude while building a book of genuinely good credit quality. The best people in this space know that those two goals can be reconciled rather than traded off, and are curious enough to work out how. What you'll be doing Own the Express / Mid-prime product: proposition, roadmap, performance and economics, with direct accountability for the balance between growth and credit quality. Own conversion through the journey, from quote to disbursal, including how we ask customers for Open Banking data and how that affects drop-off and the quality of the book. Understand and actively manage adverse selection in marketplace-acquired lending, shaping offer, pricing and decisioning strategy to attract the customers we want and screen out the risk we do not. Work with data science to make sure our credit models are calibrated and tuned for this population rather than inherited unchanged from prime or adjacent segments, and be able to get into the data yourself when needed. Use credit and commercial insight to optimise unit economics, balancing approval rates, pricing, loss rates and volume so the product scales profitably. Monitor product and portfolio performance across the customer lifecycle, spotting emerging trends, risks and opportunities early. Shape underwriting strategy, segmentation, credit policy and decisioning logic in partnership with risk and data science. Design and evaluate experiments and strategy changes, and turn the analysis into clear, actionable recommendations. Own the management information for the segment: define the metrics, monitoring and reporting that let the business make consistent decisions about the product. Assess new initiatives, customer segments and product changes with both a commercial and a credit lens. Present clear, structured updates on product performance to senior leadership and governance forums, and support funding and due diligence conversations where the product is in focus. Credit-literate. You understand how eligibility, pricing and underwriting decisions shape the book you end up with, and you have a working understanding of adverse selection and why it matters in marketplace lending. Commercially sharp, with a solid grasp of unit economics and a clear understanding that product decisions in lending have to work for both growth and portfolio performance. Curious about trade-offs rather than defensive about them: alert to the fact that deeper affordability assessment can hurt conversion, and motivated by the challenge of capturing its value without sacrificing growth. Able to move between detail and direction: happy getting into the data on a Tuesday and shaping the roadmap on a Wednesday. Confident challenging assumptions and turning analysis into practical action, and able to explain your reasoning clearly to people who are not analysts. Collaborative and credible with risk, commercial, engineering and data science teams. Structured, proactive and comfortable in a scaling environment where priorities evolve quickly and ownership is expected. Experience and background Around four to five years of experience in product, credit strategy, analytics or a closely related role within consumer lending or fintech. We are deliberately targeting this level: this is a step-up role for someone ready to own a product, not a lateral move for someone who has run several. Experience in unsecured consumer lending, ideally Unsecured Personal Loans (UPL), with exposure to the mechanics of acquiring customers through price-comparison or aggregator marketplaces. Direct experience in higher-APR or near-prime lending is a strong plus but not a prerequisite. Hands-on data skills: SQL as a minimum, and ideally Python or R for analysis. You do not need to be a data scientist, but you need to be able to work alongside them as a peer and do your own analysis. Experience working with or alongside credit decisioning, scorecards or risk models, and an understanding of how they are built, monitored and adjusted for a specific population. Some experience of pricing, eligibility or offer design, and of using experiments or A/B tests to evaluate changes. A track record of using analysis to influence decisions, not just to report on outcomes, in a role where you had some accountability for commercial results. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders. Experience with Open Banking data or cashflow underwriting is a plus, as is experience in a fast-growing fintech. title: Project Engineer (Data Centres & Industrials)
description: About the role Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for data centres and large industrials. We're looking for a Project Electrical Engineer to be the electrical owner on first-of-a-kind power projects - private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, MV and HV grid connections. This is a technical role with a unique expanded scope to broader infrastructure project management. Early on you are the project manager: you hold the programme, the development budget and the external parties, from concept design through connection offer to design freeze and financial close. From there you stay on as the electrical owner through construction, commissioning and energisation, with a delivery team around you. What you'll do Own the programme and the development budget. Schedule from early concept to design freeze - siting, connection application, planning, consents, procurement, long-lead items - worked back from the customer's energisation date. Appoint and manage consultants, ICPs and study providers. Surface risk early and clearly communicate them to the stakeholders. Own the electrical concept through to sign-off. Single-line diagrams, general arrangements, switchgear and plant layouts, cable routes, metering and comms architecture. Direct and interrogate the studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, earthing, power quality). Chair design reviews and stage gates, and take options to the Project Lead and customer with a recommendation. Lead the grid interface. DNO, TO and NESO - applications and offers, technical requirements, securities and milestones, contestable and non-contestable scope, ICP/IDNO coordination, MPAN registration. Budget ownership through completion. Credible capex inputs for the project model across plant, substation, civils and enabling works, with value engineering and optioneering. Then FAT/SAT witnessing, commissioning plans and sequences of operation, energisation and handover. Take on what you haven't done before. First-of-a-kind means no precedent, no standard design and no colleague who's done it. Get to a working understanding of an unfamiliar technology or scope fast, and deliver it. What you'll have Master’s degree, or equivalent, in electrical or power systems engineering. CEng welcome, not essential. 5+ years delivering energy or infrastructure projects, with a strong grounding in MV and HV systems. Real infrastructure experience - substations, networks, industrial plant, data centres, utilities, water or transport. We care that you've dealt with ground conditions, easements, consents, tie-ins to live assets and construction sequencing. This is not a grid-only role. You've personally held a programme and a budget on a development or pre-construction project. A GB/European grid connection taken from connection offer to grid code compliance and energisation, with working knowledge of the Grid Code, CUSC, SQSS, G99/G100, ENA engineering recommendations and BS 7671. Able to coordinate a multi-discipline design where you're not the expert in every discipline - and to spot a weak answer from a civil or mechanical engineer. Comfortable as the single point of accountability with an incomplete picture, holding external parties accountable without formal authority. Full UK driving licence and willing to travel to site. BESS, private wire, microgrid or behind-the-meter generation; data centre or mission-critical power (MV/LV distribution, UPS, generators, redundancy topologies, commissioning levels); study tools (ETAP, PowerFactory, IPSA, PSS/E, PSCAD) or Python; IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, SCADA and metering data flows; NEC or FIDIC contract and change management. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets. We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero. OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model. Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions. By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization. About the role The tools are already here. Like the rest of OE Group, OEGEN runs on Databricks, we're moving onto our own Microsoft 365 tenant, and Octopus Energy Group gives us access to a powerful set of shared data and AI capabilities. What we're missing is someone whose job is to make all of it work together for our Fund Management business - and then build genuinely useful things on top of it. This is a two-sided role. On one side, you'll integrate: wiring third-party systems, internal apps and document storage into the environment we already have, setting sensible guardrails around access and cost, and adopting existing Group capability wherever it does the job rather than rebuilding it. On the other, you'll build: turning those connections into data products, internal tools and AI-enabled workflows that fund management, asset management and finance use every day. Tying the two together, you'll develop and own the playbook - the documented, repeatable patterns for how a new system gets connected, how a tool gets built and shipped, and how both get supported afterwards - so that what you learn once becomes how the whole team works. The two halves feed each other: you'll understand what's possible because you built the plumbing, and you'll build better plumbing because you know what people actually do with it. We want someone with genuine ideas about where AI can take a business like ours, and the pragmatism to ship them. Our team has already built an Excel data mart plugin that puts gold-layer tables directly in the hands of non-technical staff, a metrics taxonomy app that keeps third-party definitions aligned with our own, and AI-assisted workflows that scaffold documentation automatically. There's a long list of things we haven't got to yet. Expect roughly half your time on integration and enablement and half on building, and expect to work closely with the central data platform team so what we do in OEGEN stays consistent with the wider estate and our specific needs get onto their roadmap. What You'll Do Integrate the systems our business runs on - third-party providers, internal tools, our own SharePoint and Microsoft 365 tenant - into our existing Databricks environment, via APIs and existing connectors. Build data products on top of what you connect: well-modelled, documented, reusable datasets that the business consumes directly through Excel, dashboards and natural-language querying, rather than one-off extracts. Design and ship internal applications and AI-enabled tools - using Python, Streamlit , Databricks Apps (HTMX) , Lakebase , FastAPI or similar - that put data and AI directly into the hands of fund management, asset management and finance teams. Prototype, evaluate and productionise new AI capability, from document AI and retrieval to agentic workflows, and turn the ideas that prove out into supported products rather than abandoned experiments. Take an adopt-first approach: work with Octopus Energy Group's data platform and AI teams to reuse capability that already exists, and configure it for OEGEN rather than building parallel versions of it. Set up practical guardrails inside Databricks and Unity Catalog - schema and workspace access, permissions, environment hygiene - so more teams can use it without stepping on each other. Bring cost management from reactive to proactive: tagging, budgets, alerting and usage monitoring, so Databricks and AI token spend can be attributed to the right team, project or fund before the invoice arrives. Get our AI usage properly credentialed and logged - managed keys and access rather than API keys sitting in individual password managers - and provide clean patterns for embedding AI into the tools we build. Standardise how we build and ship internal apps: shared templates, authentication, deployment and documentation, so a tool remains supportable by someone other than the person who wrote it. Consolidate the ad-hoc scripts, spreadsheets and no-code workflows we've accumulated into fewer, better-understood integrations that don't need babysitting, and automate the repetitive parts of our own workflow. Work directly with non-technical teams to understand their problems and translate them into things we can build. What You'll Need Strong systems integration experience - connecting business systems, SaaS tools and data sources via REST APIs, connectors and authentication flows. A track record of building and shipping data products or internal applications that people actually use , not just pipelines that feed someone else's reports. Solid Python and SQL, used daily for building, automation and data modelling . Hands-on experience with a cloud data platform in production (Databricks preferred): workspaces, catalogs, permissions and compute . Practical experience integrating AI into real tools - LLM APIs, retrieval, agents - with a clear-eyed sense of what works and what's still a demo. Practical identity and access experience - SSO, service accounts, credential management and access lifecycle - enough to make sensible, secure choices without a security team holding your hand. Experience with Microsoft 365 / SharePoint integration, or a comparable enterprise document and collaboration stack. Real experience keeping cloud or AI usage costs under control: you know what drives the bill and how to attribute and cap it. A pragmatist's instinct for adopting over building where infrastructure is concerned - you'd rather configure something that exists than write something new - paired with a bias toward shipping when it comes to solutions. Clear communication. You can explain a trade-off to a fund manager and hold your own in a technical review with a central engineering team. Comfort with real ownership in a small team, where you set the working patterns rather than inherit them. Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem - Unity Catalog, Databricks Apps, Lakebase , Genie - or equivalent tooling. Experience with vector search, embeddings, document AI or retrieval-augmented generation in production. Experience with Terraform, GitHub Actions or similar, to keep configuration version-controlled and repeatable. FinOps experience: usage monitoring, budgets, showback and chargeback. title: Finance Forecasting Modeller
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting Team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting team (CIF) sits at the intersection of our Borrowing and Finance collectives, responsible for developing, executing and managing the models used to calculate IFRS 9 ECL, and credit risk capital through the annual ICAAP. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply.
